body.statement: For a linear recursive structural equation model whose directed support is a rooted spanning tree and whose bidirected support is arbitrary (bows included), the randomized polynomial-time procedure of Gupta and Bl\"aser decides, for every queried directed coefficient, whether its generic single-coordinate degree is \(1\), \(2\), or infinite.  In each finite case it returns the corresponding one or two \(\operatorname{FASTP}\) expressions for the queried coefficient.

attestation.note: Claim scope and locator were supplied by the round-2 orchestrator directive; the stable arXiv handle is provided because the frozen core contains no verbatim transcription.

body.justification: This published result is the complete algorithmic substrate for the exact zero-excess class transfer.
body.gap: It applies to rooted tree-shaped directed support, not to positive excess-parent budget.
body.consumer: The zero-excess branch of the symbolic dispatcher uses its exact classification and finite expressions.
